name: telego-5a981bcb-blind30-ots
instr:
# telego: calls that answer backwards, updates that never arrive, without a test suite

A program that drives a chat account through this library now reports the opposite of what actually happened in a great many places, and elsewhere it quietly does the wrong thing. Nothing in the remote service changed and nothing in my own code changed; the same work that used to go through cleanly now comes back inverted or mangled. The repository has received 30 separate undocumented edits.

Asking the service to do something is where I noticed it first. Updating the short blurb shown on my account's profile reports a failure when the server answers normally, and reports success when the outgoing request could not even be assembled. Clearing every pinned message inside one discussion thread behaves the same way, and so does closing the main thread of a discussion-style chat. Asking a customer to pay for something is inverted the same way: a normal round trip that yields a message comes back as a failure, while the case where the outgoing payload could not be prepared comes back with nothing wrong reported.

The plumbing that carries a request out and brings a reply back is misbehaving in its own right. Turning a small structure of two plain fields into a JSON body no longer produces the encoded bytes and reports trouble instead.
